book.name: Luqaasa Mishiraachcho
book.title: Luqaasi Xaafida Nu Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa Mishiraachcho Qaala

content: Yesusa Kaallidaytanne Izas Ooththida Maccassata
Hessafe guye Yesusi Xoossa Kawoteththa Mishiraachcho sabbakishe dumma dumma katamata giddoranne gutata giddora aadhdhides. Aadhdhi biza wode iza kaalliza tammanne nam7ati izara deettes.
Qasseka tuna ayanappenne iita hargefe paxida issi issi maccassati izara deettes. Isttika laappun tuna ayanay izippe kezida Magdale geetettiza dereppe yida Maaramo,
Kawo Herdoosason ooththiza Kuza machcho Yohaano qasseka Soosinonne hara daro maccassati deettes; isttika banttas diza miishshara Yesusas ooththizayta.
Kath Zerizaade Leemiso
Daro derey issife shiiqi dishin qasseka asay dumma dumma katamappe izakko wodhdhiza wode Yesusi leemisora tamaarsishe,
«Issi goshshanchchay zereth zeranaas kezides; izi zerishin baggay ogen wodhdhidi asa tohon yedhettides; salo kafotikka yiidi maxi mida;
Issi zereththay shuchcha gaden wodhdhidi heerakka caarides; gadezikka mela gade gidida gishshas elle melides.
Qasseka hara zereththi agunththa giddon wodhdhides; agunththayka izara issife diccidi caarechchayka diccontta mala cuullides.

Qasseka hara zereththay aradda gaden wodhdhides; caaridi xeetu kushe ayfides» gides. Yesusi Leemison Haasayda Gaaso (Mato 13:10-17; Mar 4:10-12) Yesusi haasayaa wursidaappe guye qaala dhoqqu histtidi, «Siyiza hayththi diza asi siyo!» gides.
Yesusa kaallizayti, «Zereththaa leemisozas birsheth imma» giidi oychchiin,
izikka isttas, «Xoossa Kawoteththaa xuura eroy inttes imettides; haratas gidikko leemisora yootays qasseka harati be7idi wozinan woththontta malanne siyidi yuushshi qoppontta mala hanides.
Yesusi Birshida Zereththa Leemiso
«Zereththaza leemisoykka hayssa; zereth geetettidayssi Xoossa qaala.
Oge lanqen wodhdhidayssi qaala siyizayta; gido attiin istti ammanidi attontta mala Xala7ey yiidi qaalaa istta wozinappe ekkichchizayta.
Shuchcha bolla wodhdhidaytikka qaala siyidi ufayssara ekkizayta; isttika ha7is ammaneettes attiin metoy istta bolla gakkiza wode xapho yeddontta gishshas ellera ammano kaddizayta.
Agunththa giddon wodhdhidayti qaalaa siyizayta; heytikka hayssa ha alame qofaninne aqotan, ha biittaa bolla duussa lo7eteththan cuulettidi lo7eththi ayfe imettenna.
Aradda biittan wodhdhidayssi qaalaa suureninne lo7o wozinan siyidi naagizaytanne dandayan minnidi ayfe ayfizayta.
Qoncceson Diza Xomppe
«Poo7o poo7isidi baaththa giddon woykko arsa garsan woththiza asi deenna; gido attiin keeththe geliza asas poo7ana mala qoncceson woththeettes.
Qotettidi qoncce kezonttay, poo7on kezidi erettontta geeman attana miishshi deenna.
«Hessa gishshas intte siyizayssa naagetti siyite; diza asas gujettana; bayndaades ubbaafe izas dizaa misatizaarakka ekettaychchana» gi zaarides.
Yesusanne Iza Ishata
Hessafe guye Yesusa aayanne iza ishati Yesusaakko yida; gido attiin asaa daroteththafe dendidayssan izakko shiiqanaas dandaybeettenna.
He wode asay Yesusas, «Ne aayeyanne ne ishati nena beyanaas koyidi karen eqqida» giidi yootida.
Yesusikka zaaridi, «Ta aayanne ta ishati Xoossa qaala siyidi naagizayta» gides.
Yesusi Abba Dambalaza Seerides
Issi gallas Yesusi bana kaallizaytara wogolo giddo gelidi, «Abbaafe he pinth pinnoos» gides.
Isttika pinnishin abbaa bolla dambalay dendidi waayisiza wode Yesusi dhiskides; haaththika wogoloza giddo geliin asay daro metotettides.
Yesusa kaallizayti izakko shiiqidi, «Godoo! Godoo! Nu wurana hanoos» giidi Yesusa dhiskofe denththida. Izikka beeggidi carkozanne abba dambalaa seeriin carkoynne abbaa dambalay co7u gides.
Izikka bana kaallizayta, «Intte ammanoy awa bidee?» gides; isttika ba giddon babbishenne malalettishe, «Carkonne haaththe azazizay; isttika izas azazettizay izi oonee?» gida.
Daydanththi Oykkiin Yesusi Paththida Addeza
Izappe guye Galilappe he pinththan diza Gergesenoone geetettiza dere wogolora pinnida.

Yesusi wogolozappe gaden wodhdhiin daydanththi iza bolla diza issaadey katamappe kezidi iza demmides; he addezi daro wode may7o may7ontta kallo dizaadenne keeththan aqontta duufo baas aqoso ooththida asa.
Yesusa be7ida wode waassishe Yesusa sinththan kundides; qaalaa dhoqqu histtidi, «Bonchcho Xoossaa Naa Yesusaa! Taassinne nees ay gaytoteththi dizee? Ne tana waayisontta mala ta nena woossays» gides.

Tuna ayanay hessa gaanaas dandayday addezappe kezana mala Yesusi azazida gishshassa. Tuna ayanazikka woden woden dendiza gishshas addezi sansalataninne biratan toho qachchi naagiinkka qashettida sansalataa duusereththidi iza bolla diza daydanththay iza duge bazzo zaari efees.
Yesusi, «Ne sunththi oonee?» giidi oychchides; izikka daro daydanththati izan gelidi diza gishshas ta sunththi, «Leegoone» gides.
Daydanththatikka bana wurseththi baynda ciimma ollan yeggontta mala minththidi woossida.
Heenkka zuma bolla daro guddunththi heemettees; daydanththati, «Guddunththa wudezan gelite» giidi azazana mala woossiin Yesusi, «Ero gelite!» gides.
Daydanththati addezappe kezidi guddunththatan gelida. Guddunththati aafoza dugunththaara bichcharishe biidi abbaan geli mitettida.
Heemmizayti hanidayssa be7ida wode beerotti biidi katama asaassinne dere asaas yootida.
Hanidayssa beyana giidi asay ba dizasoppe Yesusaakko yides; daydanththay izappe kezida addezikka kahay simmiin afala may7idi Yesusa toho giddon uttidayssa be7idi babbida.
Daydanththan oykettida addezi paxishin be7idayti izi waani paxidaakko derezas yootida.
Gergesenoone matan diza asay keehi babbida gishshas Yesusa, «Hayssafe kichcha!» giidi woossida; izikka wogolozan gelidi simmi bides.
Daydanththay izappe kezida addezi Yesusara issife daana mala woossides.
Gido attiin Yesusi iza, «Neso simmada Xoossi nees ooththida gita miish ubbaa yoota» giidi moyzides; addezikka Yesusi izas ooththida gita miish ba kataman diza asaas ubbaas qonccen yootishe bides.
Iya7iroosa Nayonne Yesusa May7o Bochchida Maccassayo
Asay wuri Yesusa yuussaa naagishe gam7ida gishshas izi simmishin ufayssan mokki ekkides.
He wode Iya7iroosa geetettiza Ayhuda Woosa Keeththa halaqay yiidi Yesusa toho bolla kundidi baso baana mala woossides.
Izi hessaththo oychchiday izas tammanne nam7u layth kumida issi macca nay sakettada shempo bolla diza gishshassa. Izi hee buussan dishin derey daridi ba giddon sugettidi iza keehi un7isides.
Tammanne nam7u layth suuththi izippe gukkishin diza issi maccassaya baas diza miishshaa wursa dhale eriza asatas imma wursiin izo paththanaas dandayda asi issaadeyka deenna.
Izakka guyera shiiqada Yesusa afala macarata bochchadus; izippe gukkiza suuththay heerakka eqqi aggides.
Yesusikka, «Tana bochchiday oonee?» gides. Wurikka nuni bochchibeekko gi kaddida wode Phexroosi zaaridi, «Godoo! Asi wuri yuuyi aadhdhidi nena sugereththidi un7isees» gides.
Gido attiin Yesusi, «Asi tana bochchides; wolqqay taappe kezidayssa ta erays» gides.

Maccassaya erettontta qotettada baanaas dandayonttayssa erada kokkorashe yaada Yesusa sinththan kundadus; izakka Yesusa waana bochchidaakkonne qasseka ellera waana paxidaakko ubba asaa sinththan yootadus.
Izikka, «Ta nayee! Ne ammanoy nena paththides; saron ba!» gides.

Yesusi buro maccassays haasaya bolla dishin Ayhuda Woosa Keeththa halaqa Iya7iroosa keeththafe issi asi Iya7iroosas, «Ne naya hayqqadus; hessa gishshas hayssafe guye astamaareza mela daabursofa!» gides.
Yesusi hessa siyidi Iya7iroosa, «Aykkoy baa; babbofa! Ammana attiin ne naya paxana» gides.
Yesusi Iya7iroosa keeththe geliza wode Phexroosa, Yohannisanne Yaaqoobe qasseka nayi aawappenne aayppe attiin haray oonikka izara gelana mala koyibeenna.
He wode asay wuri nays, «Wu! Wuy» gi waassi yeekkishin Yesusi, «Yeekkofte; iza ichchadus attiin hayqqabeekku» gides.
Asaykka naya hayqqidayssa eriza gishshas Yesusa bolla miiccides.
Gido attiin nayi kushe izi oykkidi, «Ta nayee! Denda!» gides.
Nays shemppoyka simmides; heerakka denda eqqadus; Yesusikka izis miza miish immana mala azazides.
Nayo yelidaytikka malalettida; gido attiin izi hanidayssa oonaska yootontta mala azazides.
